title: Literature in English — Form 1
description: A first introduction to literature in English with original stories, poems and a short scene: the elements of a story, characters and narrators, how poems are built, simile, metaphor and personification, the shape of a play, African oral literature (folktales and proverbs) and how to answer a literature question. Official set texts are not included.
subject: english
programRef: Form 1 Literature in English — general skills only; the official set texts (prose, poetry, drama) must be added by a teacher (to be checked against the official programme)
authors: CastBridge — brouillon rédigé avec une IA, à relire par un enseignant
